Parking garages and open parking lots shall be capable of supporting and equipped with EVSE as set forth in sections 28-315.12.1 and 28-315.12.2, and in accordance with the New York city electrical code.
(L.L. 2024/055, 4/6/2024, eff. 12/21/2025)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2024/055.
